items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: they had made an arrangement for George to play three weeks with Kaye in Germany

ctx.x: Didn't get into Holland or Switzerland?
No, no, no. I stopped in Holland on the plane, but I mean, I didn't get off the plane. I got off the plane and I didn't see anything, but, you know, it's outside. Yeah, they, they, they.

The airport. Well, what it was, we had a chance to go to all those places, to Italy, France, Vienna, all those places we had a chance to go to after we got there. But trouble was, when they signed the contracts, they had made an arrangement for George to play three weeks with Kaye in Germany, you see. And after we got there, everybody wanted to book the band in these different places, you see. They wanted the band to play in Holland, Vienna, Italy, France, Austria, and Belgium. But by having them three weeks,…
